transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you for calling S-Net, this is Martin. What can I do for you?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: I've been cut off in the middle of calls twice today, once with my doctor. This keeps happening at home and I'm sick of it.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Can I take your PIN, please?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thanks, Faisal. Does it happen anywhere else, or only at home?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Only at home. Fine everywhere else.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Do you have wifi at home?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Is wifi calling switched on in your phone settings?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Calls dropping is down to the mast operator, not S-Net, you'd need to complain to them. But wifi calling should get round it. Go to settings, phone, wifi calling, and switch it on.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Can you make a test call to someone and stay on it for a minute?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Calling my wife. Okay, that's a minute, still on, sounds clear.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Good, so calls at home are working on wifi now. Is that okay?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you for choosing S-Net, Faisal.
